close_reason: The bead's diagnosis of 'statically unreachable wildcard' was wrong — BackendSetError IS #[non_exhaustive] (the bead author missed the attribute above the derive). Wildcards are reachable iff a future jmap-server release adds a variant. Bound the wildcard as Err(other) and included format!("{other:?}") so future variants' Debug repr round-trips to the client rather than being silently swallowed. 8 sites touched. Implementation in commit c436820.
title: Three /set handlers have wildcard 'Err(_)' arm after Err(SetError) and Err(Other) that is statically unreachable
